summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction (best version v2). Vertices A, B, C, D, E, N are defined from measured CV points. Segments are A–N–D–B (solid), CB, CE, BE, DE (ending at D), CD, AC (solid), and CN (dashed), with a right-angle mark at N. v1 failed to compile because coordinate E was undefined, and the topology check flagged AN, DN and DB as unverified. v2 fixed both. The Critic scored v2 at 0.88, with must_repair=false, all six labels present, and topology check passed.
